source: KEYNOTE-942 5-Year Follow-up, Journal of Clinical Oncology / ASCO 2026 (June 1, 2026)
contestNote: Phase 2b result (n=157) in high-risk resected melanoma; 5-year RFS HR 0.51 (49% reduction), DMFS HR 0.411 (59% reduction), OS trend HR 0.471 (not statistically significant due to small events). Phase 3 INTerpath-001 (n=~1,089) fully enrolled; pivotal results 2026–2029.

delta: June 2026 additions: Cavhanza nilotinib ODT for CML (June 2), generic eribulin (Lupin/Natco) for metastatic breast/liposarcoma (June 3); FDA fast-track granted giredestrant (June 2); daraxonrasib expanded access authorized ahead of full NDA

label: Daraxonrasib OS Hazard Ratio vs. Chemo in 2L Pancreatic Cancer
source: RASolute 302 Phase 3, NEJM / ASCO 2026 Plenary Session (June 1, 2026)
delta: 13.2 months vs. 6.7 months median OS — first drug to nearly double survival in 2nd-line pancreatic cancer
deltaNote: Largest OS benefit ever demonstrated in a Phase 3 trial for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. RAS mutations (primarily KRAS G12D, G12V) drive ~90% of PDAC; daraxonrasib is an oral pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor. FDA expanded access authorized; NDA filing accelerated for 2026 submission.
